description: Allow public search pages and discovery assets without browser-only header checks
expression: http.host eq "lifetech.fyi" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/index.html" "/about" "/start" "/org-events" "/calendar" "/map" "/ecosystem" "/ecosystem/network" "/taxonomy" "/datasets" "/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/sitemap-pages.xml" "/sitemap-events.xml" "/sitemap-organizations.xml" "/favicon.ico" "/favicon.png" "/apple-touch-icon.png" "/manifest.webmanifest" "/orgportal.webmanifest" "/site.webmanifest"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/events/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/orgs/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/"))
